data.name: PIECES OF THE DEEP
data.detailed_description:
Run through the depths.
Recover the relics of a lost civilization.

PIECES OF THE DEEP is a roguelite action game built around auto-running exploration, where split-second decisions determine survival.

You play as Nyarmar, a small creature who lost its home in a massive seabed quake.
Rescued by a team of surface-dwelling explorers, you repay their kindness by helping with dangerous deep-sea expeditions.

■ Procedurally Generated Dungeons × Instant Decisions

Each dungeon is procedurally generated.
Your character runs forward automatically—your role is to dodge hazards, defeat enemies, and choose branching paths while pushing toward the depths.

Simple controls, demanding judgment.
Every moment matters.

■ Recover Relics and Expand Your Base

At the end of each dungeon awaits a powerful boss.
Defeat it to obtain relics left behind by an ancient civilization—materials and incomplete blueprints scattered across the seabed.

Back at base, recovered relics are analyzed and used to restore advanced technology,
unlocking new capabilities for even deeper dives.

Explore. Recover. Grow stronger. Dive again.

■ A Story from the One Who Retrieves

You are not the one who deciphers the past.
You are the one who descends—again and again—to bring something back.

This is not the story of a hero who saves the world,
but a record of those who recover what was lost.

■ Streaming & Content Creation Policy

Gameplay videos, livestreams, and other related content are welcome.
Monetization is allowed for both individuals and organizations.

No prior permission is required.
Including a link to the Steam store page in your description is appreciated.

data.short_description: An auto-run roguelite set in the deep sea where split-second decisions decide survival. Explore procedurally generated underwater dungeons, defeat bosses, and recover relics of a lost civilization. Return with materials to rebuild technology and push further into the depths.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (4th generation equivalent) or equivalent AMD processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU (Intel UHD Graphics 630 / integrated GPU on Apple Silicon or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280×720 resolution, 30 FPS target
